channel.title: KRNBRY Studio Journal
channel.description: Reflections, articles and thoughts on where KRNBRY Studio is heading.

item.title: First Reflection
item.description:
Finally, after months of mulling over how I wanted everything to look, I feel like things actually look the way I want them to. I know this is only the start, but I hope I can continue to grow this vision along with myself.

Thank you for following me on this journey.

Will continue to update.
